units.source: Jump to & command palette
units.context: Jump to & command palette

units.source: Jump to Note__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Jump to Note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ function allows easy navigation between notes by searching for their title. In addition to that, it can also trigger a full search or create notes.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note

units.source: To enter the “Jump to” dialog:
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note

units.source: In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__, press __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note

units.source: Using the keyboard, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__ + __TRILIUM_PH_2__J__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note

units.source: In addition to searching for notes, it is also possible to search for commands. See the dedicated section below for more information.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note

units.source: Interaction__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: By default, when there is no text entered it will display the most recent notes.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: Using the keyboard, use the up or down arrow keys to navigate between items. Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to open the desired note.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: If the note doesn't exist, it's possible to create it by typing the desired note title and selecting one of two options:
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Create note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ places it in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note Inbox__TRILIUM_PH_3__: the note labelled __TRILIUM_PH_4__, today's __TRILIUM_PH_5__Day Notes__TRILIUM_PH_6__ if there is none, or the top level if there is no journal either. While hoisted into a __TRILIUM_PH_7__Workspaces__TRILIUM_PH_8__, the workspace's own inbox is used, then today's day note if the workspace has a __TRILIUM_PH_9__, otherwise the workspace root itself. The option names the destination, so it is always visible before the note is created.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Create child note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ places it under the note that is currently open.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: When the title search does not find a note, the bar below the results offers two ways to search further. It stays below the list, however far the results are scrolled. Both are hidden while the field is empty or lists commands.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Include note contents__TRILIUM_PH_1__ switch searches the content of the notes as well as their titles, and lists what it finds in place of the current results, without leaving the dialog. It stays on while the query changes, until it is switched off. Press __TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__ to switch it from the keyboard.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Show in full search__TRILIUM_PH_1__ opens the query in the full __TRILIUM_PH_2__Search__TRILIUM_PH_3__, in a new tab, where its options can refine it. Press __TRILIUM_PH_4__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_5__+__TRILIUM_PH_6__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_7__ to run it from the keyboard.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: To see the keys the results answer to, click the __TRILIUM_PH_0__?__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button below the results, or press __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__F1__TRILIUM_PH_5__ while the search field is focused.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: On a wide enough desktop window, the note highlighted in the results is previewed on their right: its path, title, attributes and the start of its content. The preview follows the highlight as it moves through the results, and is left out for the command palette.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: The options to create a note are listed after the notes. When no note matches, the list says so above them. __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ opens the note that matches best, or creates the note when none matches. Otherwise, press __TRILIUM_PH_2__↑__TRILIUM_PH_3__ from the first note to reach the options to create a note.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Jump to Note > Interaction

units.source: Recent notes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Recent notes

units.source: Jump to note also has the ability to show the list of recently viewed / edited notes and quickly jump to it.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Recent notes

units.source: To access this functionality, click on __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button on the top. By default, (when nothing is entered into autocomplete), this dialog will show the list of recent notes.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Recent notes

units.source: The recent notes are grouped by when they were last visited: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Today__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Yesterday__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Past 7 days__TRILIUM_PH_5__, __TRILIUM_PH_6__Past 30 days__TRILIUM_PH_7__ and __TRILIUM_PH_8__Older__TRILIUM_PH_9__. The other note fields, such as the one in the __TRILIUM_PH_10__Move to__TRILIUM_PH_11__ dialog, show the same list when empty: press the __TRILIUM_PH_12__ button at the end of the field, or __TRILIUM_PH_13__↓__TRILIUM_PH_14__. Typing at least two characters lists the matching notes instead.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Recent notes

units.source: Command Palette__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette

units.source: The command palette is a feature which allows easy execution of various commands that can be found throughout the application, such as from menus or keyboard shortcuts. This feature integrates directly into the “Jump to” dialog.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette

units.source: Interaction__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: To trigger the command palette:
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__J__TRILIUM_PH_5__ to display the command palette directly.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: If in the “Jump to” dialog, type __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in the search to switch to the command palette.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: Interaction:
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: Type a few words to filter between commands.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: Use the up and down arrows on the keyboard or the mouse to select a command.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to execute the command.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: To exit the command palette:
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: Remove the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in the search to go back to the note search.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Esc__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to dismiss the dialog entirely.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Interaction

units.source: Options available__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Options available

units.source: Currently the following options are displayed:
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Options available

units.source: Most of the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Keyboard Shortcuts__TRILIUM_PH_1__ have an entry, with the exception of those that are too specific to be run from a dialog.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Options available

units.source: Some additional options which are not yet available as keyboard shortcuts, but can be accessed from various menus such as: exporting a note, showing attachments, searching for notes or configuring the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Launch Bar__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Options available

units.source: Limitations__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Limitations

units.source: Currently it's not possible to define custom actions that are displayed in the command palette. In the future this might change by integrating the options in the launch bar, which can be customized if needed.
units.context: Jump to & command palette > Command Palette > Limitations
